subject: physci
title: Quiz 2 — Alchemy, Dalton & the Subatomic Revolution

items.question: What was the primary goal of alchemists?
options: To discover the structure of the atom
To transform base metals into gold

items.question: Which laboratory technique was developed by alchemists and is still used today?
Which element was discovered by alchemists through the distillation of urine?
Diurnal motion refers to the:
options: Yearly movement of the Sun through the zodiac
Daily apparent east-to-west motion of celestial objects
Motion of the Moon around the Earth

items.question: The precession of the equinoxes is caused by:
options: The gravitational pull of the Moon and Sun on Earth's equatorial bulge
The movement of the Milky Way

items.question: Which of the following is a postulate of Dalton's atomic theory?
options: Atoms can be divided into smaller particles
Atoms of different elements have identical masses
Atoms combine in whole-number ratios to form compounds
Atoms are created during chemical reactions

items.question: Dalton's theory explained the Law of Definite Proportions because:
options: Atoms can change identity in reactions
Compounds always have fixed ratios of atoms of each element
Atoms can combine in any ratio
Molecules are made of a single atom

items.question: How did Dalton's atomic theory help in the discovery of new elements?
options: It provided a way to weigh atoms and identify elements by mass
It showed that elements could be created artificially
It proved that atoms were indivisible
It introduced the concept of isotopes

items.question: Who arranged the first widely accepted periodic table and predicted undiscovered elements?
Which scientist discovered the electron using cathode ray tubes?
Rutherford's gold foil experiment demonstrated that:
options: Electrons orbit the nucleus in fixed paths
The atom has a small, dense, positively charged nucleus
Protons and electrons have equal masses

items.question: What did Henry Moseley contribute to atomic theory?
options: He showed that the atomic number equals the number of protons
He proposed the plum pudding model

items.question: Niels Bohr's model of the atom proposed that:
options: Electrons orbit the nucleus in quantized energy levels
Atoms are made of a continuous positive charge

items.question: In the nuclear model of the atom, where are protons and neutrons located?
options: In the nucleus at the center

items.question: Which subatomic particle was discovered last?
